events.title: [DEMO] SDK method `stripe.charges.create` scheduled for removal
events.summary: SIMULATED EVENT for the Tracewise demo, not a real Stripe announcement. The legacy Charges creation method in the Node SDK is announced for removal. Integrations should create payments with PaymentIntents instead.

evidence.label: Simulated announcement text
evidence.detail: stripe.charges.create will be removed on 2026-12-01. Use stripe.paymentIntents.create.

events.remediation: Replace stripe.charges.create(...) with stripe.paymentIntents.create(...) and confirm the intent with the customer's payment method. Update tests and webhook handlers (charge.* to payment_intent.*).

events.title: [DEMO] Endpoint `POST /v1/charges` deprecated
events.summary: SIMULATED EVENT for the Tracewise demo. Direct calls to POST /v1/charges are deprecated in favor of the PaymentIntents API.
events.remediation: Switch raw HTTP calls to POST /v1/payment_intents, or use the official SDK. Review idempotency keys and error handling.

events.title: [DEMO] New API version published (informational)
events.summary: SIMULATED EVENT for the Tracewise demo. A new dated API version is available. No action is required unless you pin versions.

evidence.label: Informational event
evidence.detail: No affected symbols are listed, so no findings are generated.

events.remediation: Review the upgrade guide when convenient.
